question.title: AO-MA-11G-2a: release-gate allowlist widening (CHANGELOG.md + pyproject.toml) for v4.1.0 release lifecycle (two-PR plan)
question.body: AO-MA-SPM master plan §Faz 1-7 program 2026-06-01'de tamamlandi (7/7 fazlar MERGED, main HEAD f1dc032). PyPI'da hala v4.0.0; yeni feature'lar (notifier + run_governor + slice_evidence_registers + native_worker_import + quality_profile + 5 ADR + ISO 25010 + AO-MA tracking drift fix) PyPI'da YOK. Tek atomik release PR mumkun degil cunku ao-release-gate base-ref'teki gate kodunu calistirir; tek PR icinde allowlist widening + version bump + CHANGELOG entry yapilsa base-ref builder eski allowlist'i kullanir ve diff_scope fail. Bu yuzden iki PR: PR-A allowlist widening + governance, PR-B version+dep+CHANGELOG release prep. Post-PR-B merge sonra operator-authorized tag push (v4.1.0).

plan_verdict: Codex iter-1 REVISE (tek PR YANLIS; base-ref trusted gate kendi PR'indaki allowlist widening'i kullanmaz; high-risk classification scripts/ao_release_gate*.py + .claude/** nedeniyle path_sensitive_human_review tetiklenir; CHANGELOG/pyproject runtime adapter degil ama allowlist PR'i high-risk) -> iter-2 REVISE (file-count 5 yanlis, 7 olmali; high-risk raw supersession evidence (ao-ma-10-high-risk-reviews/openai+anthropic) ekle; pyproject yorum semantic boundary daralt) -> iter-3 AGREE ready_for_impl=true (anthropic raw evidence Anthropic REVIEWER rolu sarti). 5-dosya scope (raw supersession evidence dosyalari OLMADAN), onceki 11G-1 slice (#767) ayni HIGH_RISK_PATH_PATTERNS icinde supersession evidence olmadan otonom mergelandi pattern paritesi; risk al, fail olursa supersession evidence ekle.
status_note: PR-A 5-dosya scope; .github'a dokunmaz; HIGH_RISK_PATH_PATTERNS .claude/** + scripts/ao_release_gate*.py tetiklenir (3 high-risk path: .claude/plans/RELEASE-V4-1-0.md + .claude/plans/consultations/CNS-20260601-003.request.v1.json + scripts/ao_release_gate_build_payload.py); path_sensitive_human_review tetiklenir; raw reviewer pin dosyalari (ao-ma-10-high-risk-reviews/{openai,anthropic}.local-ai-review-evidence.v1.json) bu PR'da DEGISMEDI; workflow runtime state-at-landing pin (binding_mode='unchanged') + current root local-ai-review-evidence.v1.json consensus ile ao-ma-10-high-risk-supersession-evidence.v1 artifact uretir; otonom merge beklenir onceki 11G-1 paritesinde (ayni state-at-landing pattern).
resolution: Codex thread 019e809a (3 tur REVISE -> AGREE). Plan Consensus Autonomy -> direkt impl PR-A. PR-A merge sonrasi PR-B release prep + post-PR-B operator-authorized tag push.
